title: Planned fibre works affecting a network link in Adelaide
current_summary: Planned fibre works will take place on a network link between two sites in Adelaide from midnight to 6:00 am ACDT on Friday 4 December 2026. The link may be disrupted for up to 6 hours. Traffic will automatically use alternate paths, so some customers may notice slightly higher latency during this time.

cause.reason: Planned fibre works by a network provider on a link between two Adelaide sites.

updates.content: We have been advised that a network provider will carry out planned fibre works on a link between two sites in Adelaide. The works are scheduled between 12:00 am and 6:00 am ACDT on Friday 4 December 2026. The link may be disrupted for up to 6 hours during this window. Traffic will take alternate paths, so services should stay online, but some customers may notice increased latency while the works are underway. We will share an update if anything changes.
